title: CPU Organization and operation
body:
[[Motorola 68000]] 

A [[CPU]] is three parts wired together:

- **Datapath**: the registers, the [[ALU]], and the [[Multiplexer]]s choosing what feeds
  what
- **Control unit**: a [[Finite State Machine]] that asserts the control signals in the
  right order to walk the [[Fetch-Execute Cycle]]
- **Bus interface**: the connection to memory and devices over the [[System Bus]]

Everything in the datapath is [[Combinational Logic]]; everything that remembers is
[[Sequential Logic]] built from [[Flip-Flop]]s. That is the whole point of this half of the
course: the machine you programmed in [[COMPUTING MACHINERY]] is these gates.
